label: Cyberpunk city
blurb: A neon megacity: netrunners, fixers, corpo suits, street medics and mercenaries under the rain.
context: cyberpunk megacity character, neon-lit near-future streetwear
hobbies: keeping koi in a rooftop tank
quirks: tapping out rhythms on any metal surface
distrusting anything without a paper backup
naming every piece of tech {subj} owns
checking {poss} rearview optics out of habit
paying in cash out of spite
keeping a burner line no one else knows about
never sitting with {poss} back to the door
talking to {poss} own reflection in shop windows
goals: getting out of the city for good
taking down the corp that ruined {poss} family
opening a clinic that doesn't ask questions
building a rig that can't be traced
finding {poss} sister in the lower districts
earning a seat at the fixer's table
clearing {poss} name from every corp blacklist
peeves: acid rain that ruins good leather
people who don't pay on time
the smell of the lower levels
accessories: a glowing subdermal tattoo along the neck
smart contact lenses that flicker faintly
a neural jack behind the ear
a battered data-deck on a shoulder strap
a respirator mask hanging at the neck
a katana strapped across the back
a scavenged drone perched on one shoulder
default_outfits: a long technical trench coat over a fitted bodysuit, fingerless gloves and heavy boots
an oversized bomber jacket with patchwork corp logos, ripped jeans and chunky boots
a sleek high-collar jacket with glowing trim, tactical trousers and matte black boots
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): bold neon dye, undercuts and augment marks fit here more than anywhere else.
